hook: Ranking the worst birthday cake fails from 5 to 1!

items.line: Number 5: Spelling the name completely wrong.
Number 4: The cake sliding right off the table.
Number 3: The dog eating the cake before the song even ends.
Number 2: Lighting the napkins on fire with the candles.
Number 1: Smashing their face into the cake so hard the table breaks!
